vibe_rationale: Elite federation contest with a genuine surf core, but sport-first and federation-branded, with little community programming of its own.
fit_notes: Adult elite surfers, national teams and a global surf audience with a plausible performance and health angle; the spectator profile is not recorded. Only a media partner and a government backer are listed, with no commercial route found. It is a one-off in a rotating host schedule, so it works as a reach or content play rather than an ongoing partnership.
